preconditions.before: Enable a controller's MPE mode in MIDI settings; choose that controller as track input.
preconditions.after: Enable a controller's MPE mode in MIDI settings; choose that controller as track input. Enable that controller in Link, Tempo & MIDI Settings before selecting it as track input.

contract.before: Input channel selection is fixed to All Channels. Receiving/recording per-note expression requires the controller's MPE mode. Disabled-mode interpretation and hot-unplug outcome U.
contract.after: Input channel selection is fixed to All Channels. Receiving/recording per-note expression requires the controller's MPE mode. Disabled-mode interpretation and hot-unplug outcome U. This source order does not establish hot-enabling an already selected controller. Ordinary recording eligibility remains with the recording owner.

preconditions.before: Note Expression open; select a note or expression dimension.
preconditions.after: Note Expression open; select a note or expression dimension. Actually drag the envelope background for a time selection.

contract.before: Selected note has an overlay and editable Pitch/Slide/Pressure breakpoints; Velocity/Release Velocity use markers. Other notes/envelopes are dimmed. Selecting a line exposes its draggable breakpoints/segments; background drag defines selection.
contract.after: Selected note has an overlay and editable Pitch/Slide/Pressure breakpoints; Velocity/Release Velocity use markers. Other notes/envelopes are dimmed. Selecting a line exposes its draggable breakpoints/segments; background drag defines selection. Note selection and background selection are separate inputs; Pitch/Slide/Pressure use envelopes while Velocity/Release Velocity use markers.

preconditions.before: Drag a selected breakpoint or a selected line segment.
preconditions.after: Drag a selected breakpoint or a selected line segment. Select a segment by clicking near it, or Shift-clicking directly on it, then drag with the left mouse button held.

contract.before: Selected breakpoints move together. Segment in a time selection inserts breakpoints at selection edges and moves that section together. Shift-drag restricts an axis and supports finer vertical adjustment. Dragging horizontally over a neighbor can remove it. Thresholds/equal-time ordering/clipping U.
contract.after: Selected breakpoints move together. Segment in a time selection inserts breakpoints at selection edges and moves that section together. Shift-drag restricts an axis and supports finer vertical adjustment. Dragging horizontally over a neighbor can remove it. Thresholds/equal-time ordering/clipping U. Selected-point group movement, selected-time segment movement, axis restriction, fine vertical adjustment and horizontal neighbor crossing are distinct admitted gestures; no resolution ratio is specified.

evidence.after: M3; MPE-B020, MPE-B022, MPE-B025, MPE-B026, MPE-B027

preconditions.before: Use Note Expression grid, Ctrl+4 (Win)/Cmd+4 (Mac), then save clip.
preconditions.after: Use Note Expression grid, Ctrl+4 (Win)/Cmd+4 (Mac), then save clip. The Options Snap to Grid entry is another documented input.

contract.before: Grid starts disabled, is separate from other tabs and is saved with clip. Enabled edits snap to neighboring breakpoint times; creation near grid lines snaps. Pixel thresholds, grid storage and load failures U.
contract.after: Grid starts disabled, is separate from other tabs and is saved with clip. Enabled edits snap to neighboring breakpoint times; creation near grid lines snaps. Pixel thresholds, grid storage and load failures U. Actual neighboring-time movement and near-grid creation are distinct from merely toggling or saving the grid.

preconditions.before: Click outside a note then drag a highlighted non-Pitch expression vertically; alternatively select all breakpoints in one envelope then drag.
preconditions.after: Click outside a note then drag a highlighted non-Pitch expression vertically; alternatively select all breakpoints in one envelope then drag. For equal group movement select the envelope, then Ctrl+A Windows/Cmd+A Mac before vertical or horizontal dragging.

contract.before: First gesture proportionally scales Slide/Pressure/Velocity/Release Velocity over note duration, also across selected notes. Second adds equal value/time movement to selected breakpoints. Pitch is excluded from proportional scaling. Scale origin, zero crossing and clipping U.
contract.after: First gesture proportionally scales Slide/Pressure/Velocity/Release Velocity over note duration, also across selected notes. Second adds equal value/time movement to selected breakpoints. Pitch is excluded from proportional scaling. Scale origin, zero crossing and clipping U. The outside-note hover gesture applies to each named non-Pitch dimension and multiple selected notes; the equal group gesture also moves time horizontally.

preconditions.before: Pitch edit/draw with grid off; hold Alt (Win)/Cmd (Mac). Open Note Expression and invoke Zoom to Clip Selection.
preconditions.after: Pitch edit/draw with grid off; hold Alt (Win)/Cmd (Mac). Open Note Expression and invoke Zoom to Clip Selection. Z is the other documented Zoom to Clip Selection entry.

contract.before: Modifier snaps Pitch to nearest semitone; with grid on it bypasses this behavior. Zoom includes pitch bends in selected time. Chapter 12 says Fold hides over-note Pitch envelopes; availability of a separate folded Pitch Bend lane is unresolved. Tie direction U.
contract.after: Modifier snaps Pitch to nearest semitone; with grid on it bypasses this behavior. Zoom includes pitch bends in selected time. Chapter 12 says Fold hides over-note Pitch envelopes; availability of a separate folded Pitch Bend lane is unresolved. Tie direction U. Literal Pitch modifiers are Alt on Windows and Cmd on macOS, including Draw Mode; this is distinct from the Alt/Option curve gesture. Folded over-note Pitch and an optional Pitch Bend lane are not equated.

preconditions.before: Select one or multiple notes in Note Expression and invoke Clear All Envelopes.
preconditions.after: Select one or multiple notes in Note Expression and invoke Clear All Envelopes. Invoke the MIDI Note Editor context menu or a per-note expression lane context menu.

contract.before: Clear all selected notes' expression envelopes. Whether note velocities/release velocities reset, resulting defaults, undo scope and note data beyond envelopes U.
contract.after: Clear all selected notes' expression envelopes. Whether note velocities/release velocities reset, resulting defaults, undo scope and note data beyond envelopes U. Each menu provides the selected-note envelope-clearing role; marker reset/defaults and unselected-data policy remain U.

preconditions.before: MPE controller values pass a MIDI track meter; use an MPE-enabled plug-in.
preconditions.after: MPE controller values pass a MIDI track meter; use an MPE-enabled plug-in. Independently distinguish per-note changes passing the selected track meter from generic Control Bar activity.

contract.before: Meter's lowest dot indicates per-note changes in blue. Plug-in MPE mode is saved with device default configuration; MPE-enabled plug-ins with MIDI outs can output MPE. Plug-in failures, expression destinations and emitted encoding U.
contract.after: Meter's lowest dot indicates per-note changes in blue. Plug-in MPE mode is saved with device default configuration; MPE-enabled plug-ins with MIDI outs can output MPE. Plug-in failures, expression destinations and emitted encoding U. The enabled and disabled plug-in MPE Mode states are both included in the documented device-default saving role. A blue lowest track-meter dot is not proof of note delivery, isolated audio or plug-in MIDI output; those need independently admitted input/route/receiver context.

evidence.after: M2, M5; MPE-B013, MPE-B045, MPE-B046, MPE-B047

preconditions.before: Select external output target in External Instrument or track MIDI To; choose MPE then MPE Settings. For plug-in use MPE-enabled device context menu.
preconditions.after: Select external output target in External Instrument or track MIDI To; choose MPE then MPE Settings. For plug-in use MPE-enabled device context menu. After choosing MPE, reopen the menu to choose MPE Settings; the plug-in entry is in its device-title-bar context menu.

contract.before: Open MPE/Multi-channel Settings for that routing target. Track mixer access applies in Session/Arrangement. Missing target and modal cancel behavior U.
contract.after: Open MPE/Multi-channel Settings for that routing target. Track mixer access applies in Session/Arrangement. Missing target and modal cancel behavior U. Session and Arrangement mixer routes must each use their actual selected MIDI To target; merely seeing a menu does not open its associated dialog.
